name: oh-my-grok
description: oh-my-grok — OMC-scale multi-agent runtime for Grok Build

scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && node scripts/tests/test-runtime-foundation.mjs && node scripts/tests/test-hooks.mjs && node scripts/tests/test-team.mjs && node scripts/tests/test-hud.mjs
scripts.build:bridge: node scripts/build-mcp-server.mjs && node scripts/build-cli.mjs && node scripts/build-runtime-cli.mjs && node scripts/build-team-server.mjs
scripts.build:bridge:extra: node scripts/build-bridge-entry.mjs && node scripts/build-skill-bridge.mjs && node scripts/build-claude-md-coordinator.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:bridge
scripts.test:vitest:core: vitest run src/utils src/config/__tests__/models.test.ts src/config/__tests__/plan-output.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/session-id.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/payload-limits.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/swallowed-error.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:vitest
scripts.lint: echo "eslint optional; run npx eslint src when configured"
scripts.mcp:probe: node --input-type=module -e "import{Client}from'@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js';import{StdioClientTransport}from'@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/stdio.js';import{join}from'path';const r=process.cwd();const t=new StdioClientTransport({command:process.execPath,args:[join(r,'mcp/run-tools-server.mjs')],env:{...process.env,GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:r}});const c=new Client({name:'probe',version:'0'},{capabilities:{}});await c.connect(t);const {tools}=await c.listTools();console.log(tools.length,'tools');await c.close();"
